correctness.rationale: Once-subdivided K_{n,n} has 2n+n² vertices with old-old distances 2 or 4, incident old-midpoint distance 1 otherwise 3, and midpoint pairs distance 2 if sharing an endpoint else 4. Mean-zero space decomposes into (n-1)² doubly-centered midpoint modes eigenvalue c-2a, two (n-1)-multiplicity paired standard 2×2 blocks M, and two constant-family contrasts, with a=2^p,b=3^p,c=4^p. At p=beta_n=log2(n/(n-1)), Q_-=0 and all other modes are strictly negative for n>=3; at n=2 there are three zero-mass nulls. The mixed-block determinant bound 2a³>n(b-1)² and strict positivity of b-(1+3h/2+h²/2), h=1/(n-1), certify the critical signs for n>=3; above beta_n the A-vs-B old-vertex contrast gives a positive witness. Schoenberg interval and centered rank yield n²+2n-2 at n>=3 and 4 at n=2. Independently constructed graph shortest paths and computed centered spectra for n=2..7 at, below and above beta_n; these finite probes are not the uniform proof.
